about_item: 【Supportive Cushion with Thickened Egg-crate Foam】:Iweepet dog bed has upgraded the thickness of the cushion, featuring 28D high-density egg crate memory foam with a 3.7-inch thick base. This enhancement significantly boosts both comfort and support, ensuring your dog experiences ultimate coziness and relaxation while sleeping. Your furry friend will love the superior comfort，and get a dreamy sleep.

【More Secure with Half-Round Design】:Our dog bed features a s half round, wrap-around design that conforms perfectly to the sleeping positions of small dogs, sensitive dogs, injured dogs, and elderly dogs, it also provides more security for dogs to sleep. The extended plush surface of the bed further increases comfort and helps alleviate their anxiety, ensuring a restful and soothing sleep for your pet.

【Orthopedic Support for Pet with Bolster】:The side cushion design of orthopedic dog bed enhances ultimate comfort and security, providing your pet with various cozy snuggling positions. The deeply filled cushion supports your pet's head and neck, ensuring a more restful sleep. The lowered entrance protects your pet's knees and promotes easy accessibility.

【Fluffy Removable Cover-Easy to Clean 】:This calming long plush dog bed helps reduce anxiety and supports better sleep, keeping your dog feeling secure and relaxed. Featuring a removable, machine-washable cover, it’s easy to maintain for a clean and fresh resting space every day.

【Longevity with Waterproof Lining】: Egg crate foam dog bed is equipped with a smart, fully waterproof, and washable lining. This lining protects the foam from pet urine, accidents, messes, and dust, ensuring the bed stays in excellent condition, even after your dog has an accident.

【Multiple sizes to choose from】:There are a total of 4 sizes, which are: M, L, XL,XXL; M: 36 x 27.5 x 7.16 inches, suitable for dogs weighing less than 50lbs; L:41.3 x 32.59 x 7.67 inches, suitable for dogs weighing between 55-80lbs; 44 x 32.59 x7.67 inches, suitable for dogs weighingbetween 80-100lb. 47.5x35x7.6 inches,suitable for dogs weighingbetween100-120lbs.Please confirm the size of your dog before purchasing.

summary.text: Customers find the dog bed comfortable, with dogs sleeping without hanging off the edges, and appreciate its super soft interior and thick padding. The bed is easy to wash, can be taken apart for cleaning, and offers good value for money. Opinions are mixed regarding size, with some finding it perfect for large dogs while others say it's too small for German shepherds. The thickness receives mixed feedback, with some praising the impressive padding while others note it's not as thick as advertised. Durability is also mixed, with some praising its durability while others find it not very durable.

authors_reviews.title: Dog and I love it, easy to clean, very comfortable
authors_reviews.text: Great bed. Very easy to wash, so thick and clean that my dog doesn’t want to get up! Extremely soft, looks good in my house.
authors_reviews.author: Lisa

authors_reviews.title: Definitely Worth it!!
authors_reviews.text: Love this. I bought two one for each pup and the love them. They do seem to slide much easier than expected on my wood floors when the pups run then jump into them, but they don’t seem to mind it’s all fun and hands for them. It’s very comfortable, easy to wash, a little struggle putting the edge pillow back in. The material is soft and cool. The size is perfect, the female dog has a little more room because she’s smaller but they can still both fit in one when they adjust themselves just right. I will say this has outlasted all of the many crate pads and the other puppy beds I’ve had to replace since the female dog is super destructive and chews open all the corners, edges, and pulls out the insides.
authors_reviews.author: Jessica D.

authors_reviews.title: Great Quality, but not for Giant Dog Breeds
authors_reviews.text: My dog and I both love this bed! It has two zippers: one for the mattress part, and the other for the bolster! This means it can be completely taken apart for washing. Also, the mattress comes with it's own mattress protector! How cool is that? I've washed mine four or five times by now, and it hasn't lost it's fluffiness or softness. Great bed. Not for giant breed dogs though. My 10mo old Great Dane will soon be too big. She already is starting to flow over, LOL!!
authors_reviews.author: Sabine S. McWane

authors_reviews.title: DOG APPROVED
